args.title: Fix issue 4402 in src/util/money.ts
args.body:
File: src/util/money.ts

The parsing of amounts in src/util/money.ts removes certain currency characters like €, $, £, ¥ but does not handle the Indian rupee symbol (₹) or similar symbols such as CHF with a space. This causes amounts with such symbols to fail to parse and return null, triggering errors like 'The amount is not a number'. Changing parseAmount to also remove symbols like ₹ or general non-numeric currency symbols would fix the issue.
